name: Acme Order Status
description: Let your assistant tell callers where their Acme order is, using the order number they give.
setup_instructions: In Acme open Settings → API, create a key with read access to orders and paste it here.

config_schema.label: Acme API key
config_schema.help: Settings → API in your Acme account.

template.name: get_order_status
template.description: Get the status and expected delivery date of an Acme order. Call it when the caller asks where their order is and has given the order number.

parameters.name: order_number
parameters.description: The order number the caller gives, for example A-10234.

template.filler_phrase: One moment, I'm checking your order.
